palette.notes: Code: 4 colours on the still, one 4-step ramp with 9 deg shift. Cream background, navy outline, one accent per gag (lilac, pink, orange) used for both sprite shading and the caption word.

lighting: Flat with a single shadow tone along the bottom of each shape, as if lit from above.
silhouette: The joke is silhouette: a ball, a pillow and a loaf of bread that pop into a cat by adding ears, face and tail. Navy outline, simple round shapes.

motion.timing: Code: median hold 233.3 ms (p25 100, p75 633.3), 2.0 drawings/s, on 7s: held poses and pop-in transformations, timed to the chiptune lyric.

texture: Clean pixels, almost no dither (0.0001); big chunky pixel font; lots of empty cream space.
camera: Static centred frame; the sprite stays in the middle, text above, handle below. A blank beat at 3.1 s separates gags.

acting.enters: Each object appears plain in the centre with a question caption.
acting.acts: On the answer line the object transforms into a cat (ears and face pop out, tail flicks) and holds smugly.
acting.exits: Cuts to blank cream between gags, then the next object appears.
acting.depth: None; one centred hero on an empty field.

techniques: question / answer captions synced to the song
shape-to-cat transformation gag repeated three times
accent colour shared by sprite and caption word
blank beat between gags as a reset
held smug pose after the reveal
feel: 4 colours + empty cream field + ball/pillow/bread that pops into a cat on the beat = rule-of-three cozy gag
for_fred: Pixie can do a disguise gag: sit still as an object (a loaf, a cushion) while the caption asks what it is, then pop ears and face on the answer and hold. Repeat with a twist on the third go; blank beat between each.
